description: Codes that take a percentage or a fixed amount off an Order, within their dates and limits. An Order carries at most one Coupon.
detailDescription: The Coupon's terms, and every Order and Customer that used it.
formDescription: A use is counted when an Order with the Coupon is confirmed, and freed again if that Order is cancelled.
deleteDescription: A Coupon that Orders use cannot be deleted; set an end date instead.
emptyDescription: Create a Coupon, then apply its code when you enter an Order.
emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Coupons appear here once someone creates one.
notFound: This Coupon does not exist, or it was deleted.
codeHint: Letters, digits, - and _. Stored in capitals.
endsOnHint: Included. Leave empty for no end.
minimumHint: Items before discount. Leave empty for none.
eligibleHint: Pick Products or Categories (a Category includes its sub-categories). With none picked, every item is eligible.

usage.title: Usage
usage.emptyDescription: Orders that use this Coupon appear here once they are confirmed.

validation.value: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.limit: Enter a whole number from 1, or leave it empty.
validation.amount: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
